headline: Approved ending plowing and curbside trash pickup on Peterson Road; approved seeking public easements on Austin Street.
summary: Six other streets were also taken up, and most staff recommendations were accepted. A motion to end winter plowing on Austin Street after one season failed, 3-4.
decisions: No further action needed on Breton Street.
Accepted the staff recommendation for Dodge Street, 7-0.
Accepted the staff recommendation to end plowing on Beatrice Lane, 7-0.
Accepted the staff recommendation to end plowing and curbside trash pickup on Peterson Road, 5-2.
Accepted the staff recommendation for Begin Lane, 4-3.
Accepted the staff recommendation for Edgecomb Road, 6-1.
Accepted the staff recommendation for Mill Lane, 7-0.
Withdrew a motion to continue curbside trash pickup and plowing on Austin Street.
Denied, 3-4, a motion to continue trash collection and plowing on Austin Street and end winter plowing after one season.
Approved seeking a public easement for trash pickup and plowing on Austin Street, 7-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for Committee Action: No further action needed
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Dodge Street ... Motion carried. (Vote 7-0)
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Beatrice Lane ... Motion carried. (Vote 7-0)
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Peterson Road ... Motion Carried. (Vote 5-2)
Motion to accept staff recommendation for Begin Lane. ... Motion carried. (Vote 4-3)
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Edgecomb Road ... Motion carried. (Vote 6-1)
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Mill Lane ... Motion Carried. (Vote 7-0)
Motion to continue curbside trash pickup and plowing ... Motion withdrawn by Committee Chair Turcotte & Vice President Shaughnessy
Motion to continue with trash collection and snow plowing and seek public easement for trash collection, winter plowing will cease after one (1) winter season ... Motion fails. Vote (3-4)
Motion to seek public easement for trash pickup and plowing, including a public easement ... Motion carried. (Vote 7-0)

plain_text:
WESTBROOK CITY COUNCIL 
FACILITIES & STREETS MEETING MINUTES 
MONDAY, AUGUST 17, 2026 AT 5:30 PM  
WESTBROOK HIGH SCHOOL (ROOM 114) 
125 STROUDWATER ST.  
 
  
 
 Meeting called to order at 5:30pm by Facilities & Streets Committee Chair Anna A. Turcotte 
 
City Councilors Present: Michael Shaughnessy (At-Large, Vice-President), Brian McCambridge (Ward 
1), Anna A. Turcotte (Ward 3), Victor Chau (Ward 2), Amy Faulkingham (Ward 4)(joined via Zoom at 
6:00pm), Jennifer Munro (Ward 5, President), Gary Rairdon (At-Large) 
 
City Councilors Absent: None  
 
Other City Officials Present:  Eric Dudley (Director of Engineering & Public Services), Cameron Ferrante 
(Legal Counsel), Jennie Franceschi (Assistant City Administrator), Angela Holmes (City Administrator), 
Ellis Ledoux (City Clerk) 
 
  
I. EXECUTIVE SESSION  
 Request to enter into Executive Session pursuant to 1 M.R.S. Section 405-6(E) to meet with legal 
counsel regarding the legal rights and duties of the City inviting the following individuals to attend: 
Mayor, City Administrator, Asst. City Administrator, City Clerk, Director of Public Services & 
Engineering, Legal Counsel 
 Motion to enter into executive session at 5:32pm as stated above 
Moved by Rairdon, seconded by Chau 
Motion carried by a show of hands. None opposed.  
 
II. RECONVENE  
 Meeting reconvened at 6:32pm  
 
City Councilors Present: Michael Shaughnessy (At-Large, Vice-President), Brian McCambridge (Ward 
1), Anna A. Turcotte (Ward 3), Victor Chau (Ward 2), Amy Faulkingham (Ward 4)(joined via Zoom at 
6:00pm), Jennifer Munro (Ward 5, President), Gary Rairdon (At-Large) 
 
City Councilors Absent: None  
 
Other City Officials Present:  Eric Dudley (Director of Engineering & Public Services), Cameron Ferrante 
(Legal Counsel), Jennie Franceschi (Assistant City Administrator), Angela Holmes (City Administrator), 
Ellis Ledoux (City Clerk) 
 
III. GENERAL OVERVIEW  
 
 Brief Recap of Information from August 3, 2026 & Staff & Updated Responses to General Questions – 
presented by Angela Holmes (City Administrator) 
 Committee Chair Turcotte gave the floor to Angela Holmes (City Administrator)
Ms. Holmes read into the record a statement from Mayor David Morse.  
Ms. Holmes asked Eric Dudley (Director of Public Services & Engineering) & Cameron Ferrante (Legal 
Counsel) to join at the podium to discuss the recap from the last Committee meeting held on August 3, 
2026.  
 
  
IV. BRETON STREET  
 
 Staff Recommendation: No further action needed. New information received following committee 
meeting held on August 3, 2026. Breton Street was accepted as a public street in 1957. 
There were no comments received on this street for response by City Staff  
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for public comment. The following spoke: Joseph Chawes 
(Mill Lane), Angela Holmes (City Administrator) 
No Committee deliberation was required as no further action is needed.  
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for Committee Action: No further action needed 
 
  
V. DODGE STREET  
 
 Staff Recommendation: Solicit a public easement & continue to provide plowing conditioned upon 
acceptable maintenance plan. 
There were no comments received on this street for response by City staff.  
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for public comment. The following spoke:  Shawn Adams 
(60 Adams Way), Eric Dudley (Director of Engineering & Public Services) 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Committee Deliberation. The following spoke: Councilor 
Chau, Committee Chair Turcotte, Angela Holmes (City Administrator), Vice President Shaughnessy 
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Dodge Street 
Moved by Councilor Rairdon, seconded by Councilor Chau 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Councilor comment. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Motion carried. (Vote 7-0) 
Ayes: McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: None 
 
  
VI. BEATRICE LANE  
 
 Staff Recommendation: End plowing, continue to offer trash collection at nearest public street 
intersection. 
There were no comments received on this street for response by City Staff  
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for public comment. The following spoke: No one spoke. 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Committee Deliberation. The following spoke: No one 
spoke. 
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Beatrice Lane 
Moved by Councilor Rairdon, seconded by President Munro 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Councilor comment. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Motion carried. (Vote 7-0) 
Ayes: McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: None
VII. PETERSON ROAD  
 
 Staff Recommendation: End plowing, end curbside trash collection, & continue to offer trash collection 
at nearest public street intersection. 
There were no comments received on this street for response by City staff.  
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for public comment. The following spoke: Gene Ellis 
(Peterson Rd), Legal Counsel, President Munro, Suzanne Salisbury (Rep. District 128), Doug Kieley 
(Westbrook Resident) 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Committee Deliberation. The following spoke: Councilor 
McCambridge, Eric Dudley (Director of Public Services & Engineering, Committee Chair Turcotte, Legal 
Counsel, Angela Holmes (City Administrator), Gene Ellis (Peterson Rd), Ben Corriveau (Austin St)  
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Peterson Road 
Motion Carried. (Vote 5-2) 
Moved by Councilor Chau, seconded by Councilor Rairdon 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Councilor comment. The following spoke: No one 
spoke. 
Ayes Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: McCambridge, Shaughnessy  
 
  
VIII. BEGIN LANE  
 
 Staff Recommendation: Solicit public easement, continue plowing, & continue trash collection at 
nearest public street.   
Discussion: Angela Holmes (City Administrator), Committee Chair Turcotte, Councilor Chau, Councilor 
Munro, Legal Counsel, Councilor Rairdon 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for public comment. The following spoke: Shawn Adams 
(Adams Way) 
Motion to accept staff recommendation for Begin Lane.  
Moved by Vice President Shaughnessy, seconded by Councilor McCambridge 
Motion carried. (Vote 4-3) 
Ayes: McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Faulkingham, Rairdon 
Nays: Chau, Turcotte, Munro 
 
  
IX. EDGECOMB ROAD  
 
 Staff Recommendation: solicit public easement to preserve option to offer public services, continue 
snowplowing operations while current property owners reside at 853 Cumberland St.  
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for response to comments received by City Staff. The 
following spoke: Angela Holmes (City Administrator) 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to public comment. The following spoke: Andrew 
Broaddus (representing Jackie and Ron Edgecomb), Jacqueline Edgecomb (853 Cumberland St), Legal 
Counsel 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Committee Deliberation. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Edgecomb Road 
Moved by Rairdon, seconded by Vice President Shaughnessy
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for to Councilor comment. The following spoke: President 
Munro 
Motion carried. (Vote 6-1) 
Ayes McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: Chau  
 
  
X. MILL LANE  
 
 Staff recommendation: Solicit public easement, continue to provide plowing and curbside trash 
collection conditioned on acceptable maintenance plan 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Councilor Questions. The following spoke: Committee 
Chair Turcotte, President Munro, Eric Dudley, Vice President Shaughnessy 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Public Comment. The following spoke: Taylor Noonan 
(113 Mill Ln), Eric Dudley (Director of Public Services & Engineering), Councilor Rairdon, Vice President 
Shaughnessy, Belinda Hutchinson (66 Mill Lane), Joseph Chawes (48 Mill Ln) 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to committee deliberation. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Motion to accept the staff recommendation for Mill Lane 
Motion Carried. (Vote 7-0) 
Moved by President Munro, seconded by Councilor Chau 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Councilor comment. The following spoke: No one 
spoke. 
Ayes McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: None 
 
  
XI. AUSTIN STREET & ADAMS WAY  
 
 Staff Recommendation for Austin Street: End plowing. Solicit public easement & offer continued 
curbside trash collection.  
Staff Recommendation for Adams Way: No change to Adams Way recommendations  
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to responses to comments received on this street : Legal 
Counsel read letter sent via email to Mayor Morse & City Administrator, Eric Dudley (Director of Public 
Services & Engineering), 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to public comment. The following spoke: Lynda Adams (60 
Adams Way), Doug Kieley (504 Austin Street), Susan Austin (400 Austin St), Eric Dudley (Director of 
Public Services & Engineering), Councilor McCambridge, Councilor Munro, Doug Kieley (504 Austin 
Street), Shawn Adams (60 Adams Way), Ben Corrriveau (397 Austin Street), Charlotte Paulin (408 
Austin St), Ben Corriveau (397 Austin Street), Larry McWilliams (383 Austin Street), Elmer Arbogast, 
Councilor Rairdon, Councilor Chau, Karen Repasky (502 Austin St), Legal Counsel, Angela Holmes (City 
Administrator), President Munro, Councilor McCambridge, Jessica Corriveau (397 Austin Street), Paul 
Gallant (465 Austin Street), Vice President Shaughnessy, Councilor Chau, President Munro, Jessica 
Corriveau (397 Austin St), Lynda Adams (60 Adams Way), Martha Wilson (502 Austin St) 
 
Motion to continue curbside trash pickup and plowing 
Moved by Committee Chair Turcotte, seconded by Vice President Shaughnessy
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor to Councilor discussion. The following spoke: Councilor 
Rairdon 
Motion withdrawn by Committee Chair Turcotte & Vice President Shaughnessy 
 
Motion to continue with trash collection and snow plowing and seek public easement for trash 
collection, winter plowing will cease after one (1) winter season 
Moved by Councilor Rairdon, seconded by Committee Chair Turcotte 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for Council discussion. The following spoke: Councilor 
Shaughnessy, Legal Counsel 
Motion fails. Vote (3-4) 
Ayes: Munro, Rairdon, Turcotte  
Nays: McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Chau, Faulkingham 
 
 
Motion to seek public easement for trash pickup and plowing, including a public easement 
Moved by President Munro, seconded by Vice President Shaughnessy 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for Council discussion. The following spoke: Councilor 
Chau 
Motion carried. (Vote 7-0)  
Ayes McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: None  
XII. ORDINANCE DISCUSSION & NEXT STEPS 
 
 Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for Council discussion. The following spoke: Councilor 
Chau, Angela Holmes (City Administrator), Councilor Rairdon, Committee Chair Turcotte 
XIII. ADJOURNMENT 
Motion to adjourn at 10:49pm 
Moved by Councilor Rairdon, seconded by Vice President Munro 
Motion carried. (Vote 7-0)  
Ayes McCambridge, Shaughnessy, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: None
